# Welcome to Fed-Dup Discussions! 🎉

## 📋 Community Guidelines

Welcome to the Fed-Dup community! This is where we collaborate, share ideas, and help each other protect our code repositories.

### 🗣️ How to Use Discussions

| Category | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| **💡 Ideas** | Share feature suggestions and improvements |
| **❓ Q&A** | Ask questions and get help |
| **📢 Announcements** | Official project updates |
| **📝 Show & Tell** | Share how you use Fed-Dup |
| **🤝 Community** | General conversation |

### ✅ Before Posting

1. **Search first** — Your question may already be answered
2. **Be specific** — Provide details about your setup
3. **Be kind** — Follow our Code of Conduct
